insight: The `file__apply_diff` tool frequently fails on this project's TypeScript files (observed on drone-core/src/index.ts and drone-agent/.../client.ts) with "The `-` lines didn't match... near the @@ heading" even when the patch context looks correct — especially failing on blank-line-only context hunks. Reliable workaround: use `exec` with an inline Python script doing exact-string `src.replace(anchor, addition, 1)` with a unique multi-line anchor. Verified effective for inserting types, imports, and function bodies.

git stash footgun (cost real recovery time this session): `git stash push -- <paths>` where the pathspec list includes UNTRACKED files FAILS ("pathspec did not match any file(s) known to git") and — critically — stashes NOTHING. If you then run `git stash pop`, it does not pop "your" (nonexistent) stash; it pops stash@{0}, an UNRELATED pre-existing stash from another branch, dumping a foreign WIP (conflict markers in pnpm-lock.yaml, stray untracked files like knowledge-base/ dirs and unrelated plan-*.md memories) onto your tree. Recovery that worked: (1) `git stash list` — confirm the foreign stash is STILL listed (pop does not drop on conflict, so nothing is lost); (2) `git reset` to clear the conflicted index stages (working tree kept); (3) `git checkout HEAD -- <files the foreign stash touched>` for tracked files, `rm` the untracked contamination after backing it up to /tmp; (4) verify your own commits untouched via `git log --oneline`. Safer patterns: use `git stash push -u` (includes untracked) or plain `git stash push` (whole tree), and NEVER run `git stash push -- <pathspec>` mixing tracked+untracked. For "is X pre-existing?" checks, prefer `git stash` whole-tree + `git stash pop` symmetric, or just `git show HEAD:<file>` / `git log --all -- <path>` without stashing at all.

`pnpm run lint` runs `prettier --write .` repo-wide (lint = lint:eslint && lint:prettier), and pnpm-lock.yaml is NOT in .prettierignore (only `dist/` is). So a single lint run dirties the tree with an ~8000-line pnpm-lock.yaml reformat plus unrelated .drone-agent/insights/*.json newline fixes — all noise unrelated to your change, and NOT carried by HEAD (the HEAD lockfile is not prettier-clean either). After linting, before committing, `git checkout HEAD -- pnpm-lock.yaml .drone-agent/insights/` (and any other unrelated files prettier touched), then keep only the reformats of files you actually changed this session. Note AGENTS.md's warning is real: prettier will reformat your files, so re-read before further edits — and `git diff -w` will NOT show reflows (line splits/joins) as empty, since -w ignores intra-line whitespace only, not line re-wrapping.

`pnpm run lint` = `eslint --fix` then `prettier --write .` repo-wide, and the only `.prettierignore` entry is `dist/`. So every lint run reformats `pnpm-lock.yaml` (~5800-line reflow) and adds trailing newlines to `.drone-agent/insights/*.json` — none of which belong to your change and none of which HEAD is clean over. After linting and before committing, run `git checkout HEAD -- pnpm-lock.yaml .drone-agent/insights/` (plus any pre-existing memory files prettier touched) and keep only reformats of files you actually changed. Note this is already recorded as an insight in `.drone-agent/insights/project/tooling.json` — it happened again this session, so it is a recurring trap, not a one-off.
